text:
Fredericktown logs 2 scam reports for week ending Aug. 8, 2026
Two scam reports were filed in Fredericktown during the week ending Aug. 8, 2026, according to Better Business Bureau.
That was up from one report in the previous week.
Reported losses totaled $50 from the only report that listed a dollar amount. Employment scams were the most common, accounting for one report.
The largest reported loss for the week was $50 in a phishing scam described as, "Company sends only scam email responses using AI. No phone numbers to call. Repeatedly charges and send shipments."
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their own experiences to help others recognize similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to involve large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
| Date | Scam type | Reported loss |
|---|---|---|
| August 6 | Employment | No reported loss |
| August 5 | Phishing | $50 |
